name: Tharnariun Treetender
summary: In Auberdine, Tharnariun Treetender watches Darkshore’s wilds for signs of sickness. The night elf naturalist studies the corruption spreading through local plants and animals, seeking ways to protect them.

sections.title: A Guardian in Auberdine
sections.body: In Auberdine, Tharnariun Treetender watches the woods beyond the port. Hostile satyrs and foul shoreline washaways threaten the village, but his work centers on the natural world around it. He believes neglecting nature invites ruin, so he studies the decline of the local woods and searches for ways to fight the sickness spreading across the forest floor.

sections.title: Healing the Afflicted
sections.body: Strange plagues and corrupted blights have driven Darkshore’s creatures mad, turning peaceful animals into rabid threats. Tharnariun seeks a remedy instead of simply killing them out of fear. He uses cleansers and targeted efforts against the worst of the contagion, trying to save what remains of the wilderness from decay.

faq.answer: Tharnariun is a night elf caretaker in Auberdine, on the coast of Darkshore. He watches over the forest and studies the unnatural afflictions troubling its wildlife.

faq.q: Where can I find Tharnariun Treetender?
faq.answer: You can find Tharnariun in Auberdine, the night elf village on Darkshore’s western edge.

faq.q: What problems is Tharnariun investigating in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Tharnariun investigates the corruption and plagues spreading through Darkshore’s land and wildlife. He sends adventurers to cleanse infected beasts and stop the blight.

faq.q: Why does Tharnariun care so much about diseased animals?
faq.answer: Tharnariun believes neglecting nature brings consequences for the night elves. He works to cleanse sick creatures rather than abandon the forest to corruption.

faq.q: What quests does Tharnariun Treetender offer?
faq.answer: Tharnariun directs adventurers to address the blighted land and wildlife through 'Plagued Lands', 'Cleansing of the Infected', and 'Tharnariun's Hope'.
The entry does not name Tharnariun a druid outright. His concern for preserving beasts and plants echoes the Cenarion Circle, and he works as a caretaker of Darkshore’s wilderness.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you may feel the weight of Tharnariun’s warnings: your people have an ancient duty to watch over the natural balance of northern Kalimdor.
As a druid, you share Tharnariun’s concern for blighted wildlife and the work of restoring harmony to corrupted lands.
Auberdine is the Alliance’s main coastal gateway in northern Kalimdor. Tharnariun’s defense of the surrounding woods helps protect the outpost.
